selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline pre-change state on node1 (boot id, current sysctl values, no prior config)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured initial boot_id 181ad286... and pre-change values: accept_redirects default=1 (all=0), accept_source_route default=1 (all=0); no existing sysctl.d entries for these keys

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config written and live values set to 0 for all/default
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl -p; all/default accept_redirects and accept_source_route confirmed 0, but eth0/lo still showed 1 due to kernel OR-logic for accept_redirects

selected_evidence.requirement: Full persistent disablement across all interfaces including pre-existing eth0/lo
selected_evidence.summary: Extended sysctl.d file with explicit eth0/lo entries, reapplied; verified every interface (all, default, eth0, lo) reports accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0

selected_evidence.requirement: Confirm the sysctl.d drop-in is actually loaded at boot time (persistence mechanism)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed OpenRC 'sysctl' service is enabled in the 'boot' runlevel, which applies /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf before networking starts

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline snapshot immediately before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (181ad286...) and confirmed hardening values still 0 across all/default/eth0 immediately before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'sudo -n reboot' via nohup so the exec call acknowledged (pid returned) before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof node was actually down / mid-restart
selected_evidence.summary: Multiple connection reset/timeout errors while polling confirm node1 was offline during the reboot
First successful exec after reboot confirms command execution available again on node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving a genuine restart occurred, and recovered hardened state without manual reapplication
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is d8031d89... (different from pre-restart 181ad286...), proving an actual reboot; accept_redirects and accept_source_route remain 0 on all/default/eth0/lo, sysctl.d file intact, and OpenRC sysctl service shows 'started' in boot runlevel -- confirming persistent recovery
